items.title: Unsiloed AI – #1 on olmOCR-Bench
items.raw_excerpt: Most of the document parsers fail on real world challenges like complex tables, handwritten documents, historical document scans, equations, multi-column layouts, complex reading order, etc. We built Unsiloed Parser to handle exactly these cases. Our latest parser v3.1 achieved #1 rank and scored 88.0 strict pass-rate on olmOCR-Bench. We ran the evaluation across 1,403 PDFs and 8,413 unit tests using the unmodified upstream Allen AI scorer (olmocr==0.4.27) and found Unsiloed beats 18 other OCR services, including GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, LlamaParse, Reducto, Azure Document Intelligence, AWS Textract, and Unstructured. When we dug deeper into the failure cases, we found many errors were not OCR errors but things like \frac vs \dfrac, whitespace differences, or equivalent LaTeX renderings.

items.raw_excerpt: 雷峰网讯 AI 时代企业增长新逻辑 2026 年 5 月 22 日，新一期北纬诺贝巅峰对话在北京中关村学院 x 中关村人工智能研究院（简称“中关村两院”）隆重举行，本次活动由中关村两院及北纬港湾共同举办。全球知名 AI 战略专家、美国未来产业研究院创始人乔·韦曼（ Joe Weinman ）受邀出席，并发表主旨演讲——作为长期活跃于全球科技与产业前沿的思想者，乔·韦曼凭借横跨技术研究与商业战略的系统性洞察，持续为 AI 驱动下的产业变革提供前瞻性判断与实践方法论 。 本次活动汇聚了中关村两院师生、 直博生 夏令营营员及北纬 社区科创企业 负责人等各界代表，围绕 AI 时代的产业变革、商业增长与人才培养等核心议题展开深入交流 。 跨越太平洋的访问，感受中关村两院科研创新活力 活动当日，乔 · 韦曼近距离倾听了学院师生分享中关村两 院最新 科研成果，真切感受学院在前沿科技领域的创新与探索、人才培育及成果落地转化方面的 “ 超常规 ” 实践。 现场展示的前沿项目涵盖多个技术领域，包括识别准确率高达 99.9% 的病毒识别系统“ DeepVirus ”，支持跨地域机器人协同学习且可以从人类第一视角视频中学习物理常识 的具身通用 智能模型“ Physbrain ”以及基于智能体模拟人类社会行为的仿真平台等 。 围绕相关项目的技术路线、应用场景与产业化前景，乔·韦曼与现场师生进行了深入交流与探讨。他指出：这些来自不同领域的、激动人心的创新实践，生动诠释了一个重要共识： 在算力与 算法日益趋同的当下，真正驱动科技创新与产业变革的核心稀缺资源，依然是人才、认知能力、原创创造力以及高效的组织协同能力 。 思想对撞 ， 探讨 AI 时代稀缺资源与变革逻辑 参观结束后，乔·韦曼与师生面对面进行了一场深度交流，以“聚焦人工智能时代的稀缺资源与变革要点”为主题，围绕 AI 时代的核心稀缺要素、产业变

items.title: 一台手掌大小、300克的AI主机，为什么能跑122B模型？
items.raw_excerpt: 把一台能运行122B大模型的AI主机塞进口袋，需要付出什么代价？ 过去大半年，端侧AI硬件的逻辑正在发生变化。 两个月前，国内掀起一场现象级的本地部署Agent热潮，大量AI爱好者开始“养虾”，让原本偏小众的Mac mini意外出圈，一度出现溢价和缺货。在更硬核的开发者圈子里，三四万元的英伟达DGX Spark同样热度不低，因为它已经能够在本地运行千亿参数模型。 Mac mini和DGX Spark同时走红，背后其实指向的是同一个趋势： Agent正在迅速抬高端侧AI硬件的门槛。 此前，40TOPS级别的AI PC，仅能完成对话、生成等轻量任务。但进入Agent时代后，开发者开始追求更大的模型、更长时间的本地推理，以及真正能够承担生产力任务的端侧AI设备。 问题随之出现。Mac mini足够安静、低功耗，却很难支撑更大的本地模型；DGX Spark拥有强悍性能，但价格、功耗与散热，又很难真正走向大众化。大算力、低功耗与小体积之间，似乎始终难以兼得。 Agent时代真正缺少的，不再只是一台更强的AI PC， 而是一种能够7×24小时运行、低功耗、安静，并具备本地执行能力的新终端。 一种介于AI PC与AI工作站之间的Agent Computer出现了。最近发布的联想AI主机P7，仅300克、30W功耗的设备，拥有190TOPS端侧AI算力，能在本地运行122B参数模型。 AI 2.0时代，需要怎样的Agent Computer？ 传统AI更多还是一问一答式交互，任务结束后，模型也随之停止运行。但Agent不同，它需要长期在线、持续调用模型、自主拆解任务，并在本地完成记忆、推理、执行等一整套过程。 这意味着Agent设备比拼的，不再只是瞬时性能，而是长期稳定运行能力。 换句话说，AI 2.0时代真正需要的不是AI PC的简单升级版，而是一种介于AI PC与AI工作站之间的新终端

Two months ago, a phenomenal wave of local deployment of Agents swept through China, with a surge of AI enthusiasts starting to "raise shrimp," unexpectedly propelling the once-niche Mac mini into the spotlight, leading to price premiums and shortages. In more hardcore developer circles, the Nvidia DGX Spark, priced at 30,000 to 40,000 yuan, has also garnered significant attention, as it can already run a hundred-billion-parameter model locally. The simultaneous rise of the Mac mini and DGX Spark points to the same trend: Agents are rapidly raising the bar for on-device AI hardware. Previously, AI PCs with 40 TOPS could only handle lightweight tasks like conversation and generation. But in the Agent era, developers are pursuing larger models, longer local inference, and on-device AI devices truly capable of productivity tasks. The problem emerges: the Mac mini is quiet and low-power but struggles to support larger local models; the DGX Spark boasts powerful performance, but its price, power consumption, and heat dissipation make it hard to popularize. It seems difficult to achieve high computing power, low power consumption, and compact size all at once. What the Agent era truly lacks is no longer just a more powerful AI PC, but a new terminal that can run 24/7, with low power consumption, quiet operation, and local execution capability—a middle ground.

excerpt_i18n.en: On May 21, local time, the 2026 Huawei Innovative Data Infrastructure Forum, themed "Data Awakening, Storage Evolution," was held in Paris. At the event, Huawei officially launched its full-stack Huawei AIDC Data Infrastructure Solution, covering five core layers: data lake, knowledge and memory platform, model engineering and resource scheduling, agent framework, and data resilience platform. The solution aims to help enterprises accelerate AI data center construction and achieve large-scale AI deployment. Yuan Yuan, President of Huawei's Data Storage Product Line, framed the release under a clear era judgment: "Currently, AI is profoundly transforming enterprise operations. Agents are rapidly proliferating, becoming a new type of digital productivity entity and gradually evolving into regular 'digital employees' for enterprises. Meanwhile, AI applications continue to deepen, leading to an explosive growth in enterprise token consumption." The figures he cited support this judgment: the number of active agents worldwide has exceeded 30 million, expected to reach 2.2 billion within five years; the number of tokens processed per minute has surged from 6 billion last year to 15 billion this year. "Tokens will become as fundamental as air and water in our lives." Against this backdrop, Yuan Yuan noted that to accelerate AI deployment, enterprises must drive the rapid evolution of existing IT architectures toward AI DC data infrastructure, focusing on data lakes, knowledge and memory platforms, computing power, models, agent frameworks, and data resilience.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 21 de mayo, hora local, se celebró en París el Foro de Infraestructura de Datos Innovadora de Huawei 2026, bajo el lema "Despertar de los datos, salto en almacenamiento". Durante el evento, Huawei presentó oficialmente su solución integral de infraestructura de datos AIDC, que abarca cinco niveles clave: lago de datos, plataforma de conocimiento y memoria, ingeniería de modelos y programación de recursos, marco de agentes inteligentes y plataforma de resiliencia de datos. El objetivo es ayudar a las empresas a acelerar la construcción de centros de datos de IA y lograr una implementación a gran escala de la inteligencia artificial. Yuan Yuan, presidente de la línea de productos de almacenamiento de datos de Huawei, enmarcó el lanzamiento de esta solución en un contexto histórico claro: "Hoy en día, la IA está transformando profundamente los modelos operativos de las empresas. Los agentes se aceleran".
